% Checks cases the fix for an active ! in the preamble must not break:
% babel's Turkish with shorthands=:!=, which makes ! active at
% \begin{document} and adds a space before it.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[shorthands=:!=,turkish]{babel}
\begin{document}
Evet! Hayir: belki.
\end{document}
